hero.eyebrow: Technical studio for games and digital products
hero.title: Technology that carries the work.
hero.text: DuoNerds builds systems, mods, plugins, websites and tools for projects that need to work reliably over time.
hero.visualText: Structured planning, transparent delivery, clear documentation.

home.eyebrow: What we can take care of
home.title: You do not need to arrive with a finished specification.
home.text: We help you sort requirements, choose the right technical direction and turn it into a dependable solution.
home.servicesTitle: One team for the full journey.
home.servicesText: From the first technical assessment to ongoing support: you get clear next steps and one point of contact.
home.gamesText: We work across game and web ecosystems and carry good technical standards from one project into the next.
home.whyText: We explain decisions, keep assumptions visible and build so you can continue the solution after handover.
home.principlesText: Good collaboration means realistic statements, visible progress and a solution that fits the project in front of you.

principles.title: Technical clarity
principles.text: We translate ideas into concrete requirements, dependencies and next steps.

principles.title: Transparent handover
principles.text: You receive understandable progress, documentation and clear ownership.

principles.title: Flexible scope
principles.text: We start with the useful slice and expand only when the next step creates value.

home.shopTitle: A clear starting point for your project.
home.shopText: Ready-made building blocks and individual services help you start the conversation without detours.
home.contactTitle: Let us find the next sensible step.
home.contactText: A rough description is enough. We will reply directly and tell you honestly how we can help.

metin2.title: Metin2 systems, UI and careful migration
metin2.text: We support existing clients, server systems, UI modernization and technical transitions.

palworld.title: Palworld mods, server helpers and automations
palworld.text: UE4SS mods, status signals, balancing and small helpers for a stable server routine.

minecraft.title: Minecraft plugins for servers, events and communities
minecraft.text: Focused Paper, Spigot and Velocity solutions that make your network clearer and more reliable.

tools.title: Websites, dashboards and tools with structure
tools.text: Landing pages, internal helpers and small systems that put information where it belongs.

workflow.title: Every project stage stays understandable.
workflow.text: The four steps move forward and backward with your scroll path. The process stays visible without becoming a gimmick.

steps.label: 01 / Enquiry
steps.title: Clarify the goal

steps.label: 02 / Concept
steps.title: Shape the scope

steps.label: 03 / Delivery
steps.title: Build in steps
steps.text: Small milestones instead of an opaque large project.

steps.label: 04 / Handover
steps.title: Pass it on cleanly
steps.text: You know what was delivered and how to continue.
